name: Setenil de las Bodegas (Spain)
description: Vertically divided white and dark blue in the proportions 1:2, charged over the division with the crowned municipal arms of Setenil de las Bodegas (a stylised figure on red).
history: Municipal flag of Setenil de las Bodegas; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Setenil de las Bodegas arms — figure on red
